description: This is a Java test class for BooleanValueValidator, containing unit tests that verify the validation logic for boolean headers, immutability, handling of null inputs, and accepted boolean string values.

classes.name: BooleanValueValidatorTest
classes.description: A unit test class for testing the behavior of BooleanValueValidator, including validation logic, immutability, null handling, and acceptance of boolean string representations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of BooleanValueValidator before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that BooleanValueValidator instances are immutable.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullDefinition
methods.description: Tests that passing null as header definition throws a NullPointerException with an appropriate message.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullValue
methods.description: Tests that passing null as value throws a DittoHeaderInvalidException with a specific message.

methods.name: canValidateBoolean
methods.description: Checks that the validator correctly affirms it can validate boolean types.

methods.name: acceptTrueCharSequence
methods.description: Validates that the validator accepts the string representation of true without errors.

methods.name: acceptFalseCharSequence
methods.description: Validates that the validator accepts the string representation of false without errors.

methods.name: doesNotValidateAsDefinedJavaTypeIsNotBoolean
methods.description: Ensures that the validator does not throw when contexts are not explicitly boolean types.

methods.name: acceptInvalidCharSequence
methods.description: Checks that an invalid boolean string (e.g., '5') results in a DittoHeaderInvalidException.
